description: The house Nemotron desk (llm-nemotron-fest) as it is: its last turn (every 30 minutes), each market's decision and which reader decided it (the vote rule the Nemotron answers, or Jev), the facts it read, and the venue's own positions with realised and unrealised PnL. Composed from the desk's log and the venue, no model asked; a turn older than 45 minutes is marked stale. Not a forecast.

market.description: one market, or every market when absent

name: desk_read
